title: 2 killed, 7 injured in fire at resto-pub in Karnatakas Mysuru
summary: A fire at a resto-pub in Mysuru, Karnataka killed 2 people and injured 7 others in an incident at the establishment.
digest: A fire broke out at a resto-pub located in Mysuru, Karnataka. The incident resulted in 2 deaths and 7 people sustaining injuries. The resto-pub was the venue of the fire which caused the casualties and injuries to those present at the time.

title: Subodh Bhave to play Neem Karoli Baba in 'Shree Baba Neeb Karori Maharaj'
summary: Actor Subodh Bhave has been cast to play Neem Karoli Baba in an upcoming production titled 'Shree Baba Neeb Karori Maharaj'. The role centers on the spiritual life and teachings of the revered saint.
digest: Actor Subodh Bhave has been selected to portray Neem Karoli Baba (also known as Neeb Karori Maharaj) in an upcoming film or production titled 'Shree Baba Neeb Karori Maharaj'. Neem Karoli Baba was a revered spiritual saint and guru known for his teachings and spiritual legacy. Bhave's casting for this role reflects the production's focus on bringing the spiritual life and philosophy of the maharaj to the screen. The project aims to document and dramatize the life and spiritual teachings of this important religious figure.

title: SoE necessary but not sufficient, business leaders say
summary: Business leaders have stated that while a Statement of Establishment (SoE) is necessary, it is insufficient on its own as a measure for business or economic development. More comprehensive policies and support are needed.
digest: Business leaders have issued a statement asserting that a Statement of Establishment (SoE), while necessary, is not sufficient by itself. The leaders suggest that for effective business growth and economic development, SoE must be accompanied by additional measures, policies, and institutional support. The statement reflects business community concerns that procedural requirements alone, without substantive backing and comprehensive policy frameworks, cannot adequately address business needs. The leaders' position emphasizes the need for multi-faceted government and institutional support beyond formal documentation and establishment procedures.
id: soe necessary but not sufficient business leaders say

title: Railways approves Rs 341 crore Kavach rollout for Ambala and Ahmedabad divisions
summary: Indian Railways has approved a Rs 341 crore Kavach safety system rollout for the Ambala and Ahmedabad divisions. Kavach is an advanced automatic train protection technology aimed at enhancing railway safety and reducing accidents across these operational zones.
digest: Indian Railways has sanctioned Rs 341 crore for the rollout of the Kavach automatic train protection system across the Ambala and Ahmedabad divisions. Kavach is a state-of-the-art collision avoidance and speed control technology designed to enhance operational safety and reduce human error on railway networks. The project will see systematic implementation of the system across both divisions' track networks and train fleets.
id: railways approves rs 341 crore kavach rollout for ambala and ahm
